001: Is your presentation material for next week ready yet?
I'm not even halfway done, and I'm starting to feel a bit anxious.
Which part is taking you the most time?
Explaining the graphs is difficult, and I can't seem to put it into words.
Would you like me to help you a little?
Really? That would be a huge help.
002: What is the main thing you want to convey in this presentation?
The timing of the new product's market launch is the key point.
I see. In that case, it's better to state the conclusion first.
You're right, that would be easier for the audience to understand.
Try changing the structure of the material to match that as well.
I will. Thank you for the advice.
003: Have you practiced the presentation yet?
I haven't done it even once, and I'm worried about the time management.
In that case, shall we do a rehearsal together right now?
Yes, please. Could you time me?
Of course. Go ahead and start.
004: I think the text on the slides is a little too small.
Is that so? Then I'll try making it a bit bigger.
Also, you should make the colors in the diagrams a little clearer too.
You're right, it might be hard to see from the back rows.
When giving a presentation, it's important to put yourself in the audience's shoes.
You're absolutely right. I'll fix it right away.
005: How much time are you planning to set aside for the Q&A session?
I'm planning for ten minutes, but I'm worried it might not be enough.
It'll put your mind at ease if you list the expected questions in advance.
That's a good idea. I'll try that right away.
Especially, there may be a lot of questions about the budget.
I'll prepare thoroughly on that point.
006: Are you using the latest data for the presentation material?
Yes, I've incorporated the survey results that were released last week.
That's good. It increases the credibility.
However, the citation of the sources is still incomplete.
You must clearly state the sources. It's an important point.
Understood. I'll check on it right away.
007: Have you thought of a hook for the opening?
I was thinking of giving a quiz about recent market trends.
That sounds interesting. It seems like it would grab the audience's attention.
However, I'll be careful not to take up too much time.
Right. It would be good to keep it within one minute.
Got it. I'll make it short and memorable.
008: Are you planning to include a request at the end of the presentation?
Yes, I'm thinking of announcing the next meeting.
In that case, it's good to encourage the participants to take a specific action.
For example, what kind of wording would be good?
How about "Please share your opinions with us"?
That sounds good. I'll use that wording.
009: Is your computer working okay? Did you check it before the presentation?
I haven't checked it yet. I'll try it out now.
Don't forget to check the connection with the projector as well.
Yes, I'll test it early at the venue.
It'll give you peace of mind to bring a spare cable too.
I will. I'll make sure I'm fully prepared.
010: Have you thought about the follow-up after the presentation is over?
I'm planning to share the material with the participants.
That's good. Because they can review it later.
I'm also thinking about conducting a survey.
Yes, I'd like to use it to improve next time.
